title: pm daily scratchpad - launch week prep
content:
Goals for today (short):
- Finalize PRD edits for streaming fallback behavior. Need sign-off from eng + SRE.
- Confirm canary schedule with Ops (window + rollback criteria).
- Triage last-minute embedding quota bug reported by B2B pilot.
- Update launch checklist and send out reminder to stakeholders.

Morning sync notes (9:30am w/ eng + sre):
- Ben: landed kernel selection change, perf looks stable in staging (p95 latency down ~8%). Need small config tweak to avoid memory spike in long-tail.
- Ling: will push canary pipeline changes by EOD, expects 1-hour downtime window for migration (but thinks we can avoid if we do rolling). Confirming with infra.
- Marcus (SRE): want to run final soak on dedicated pool for 2 hours before canary. Suggested adding health-check for kv-cache saturation.

Action items from sync:
- Aisha: update PRD section "Fallback routing" to include new rollback triggers (error spike >3% sustained for 5m, token cost delta >25%). Due: today EOB. (linked CONFLUENCE-PRD-LAUNCH-1)
- Ben: add memory guard to runtime and publish staging build. Due: today noon.
- Ling: update canary pipeline to rolling mode and post runbook. Due: today 4pm.
- Marcus: run soak on dedicated pool tomorrow 8am, notify CS.

PRD edits (notes to self / copy to include):
- "Fallback routing" section: describe policy hierarchy (latency->capacity->cost). Add explicit sequence: primary -> cheaper model variant -> hosted fallback -> 429 with retry-after.
- Define observable metrics & thresholds for automated rollback (errors, latency, token cost regressions).
- Add short troubleshooting checklist for on-call: how to switch routing policy to conservative, where to check KV cache saturation, how to scale dedicated pool temporarily.
- Call out supported model variants and compatibility matrix (short table to add later).

Launch checklist (high level):
- Prelaunch: final PRD sign-off (today), runbook for on-call (Marcus), stakeholder announcement (GTM + CS), confirm monitoring dashboards (console).
- Canary: rolling deploy to 5% traffic for 1 hour + soak 2h if healthy. Automated rollback based on thresholds above.
- Post-canary: scale to 25% for 4h. If stable, auto-increase to 100% over 6h.
- Post-launch: 24h high-touch support window, daily check-ins for 3 days.

Risks / open questions:
- Embedding quota bug: B2B pilot reported slow failures when batch size > 64. Unknown whether it's batching logic or quantization edge-case. Marked BLOCKER until root cause. Linked JIRA-API-3245.
- Billing delta: finance flagged potential unit-cost increase with new KV caching defaults. Need cost estimate before final rollout. (Pinged finance via email)
- Legal: privacy review for private deployment customers using on-prem metrics collection — awaiting sign-off from compliance (stalled).

Quick follow-ups to send today:
- Email to GTM: draft announcement and timing. Ask them to confirm messaging by EOD.
- Slack to #eng-sre: request soak schedule confirmation and temporary runbook channel.
- Comment on GH-PR-4210: request small change to test to cover edge-case for long sequences.

Notes / small things (brain dump):
- Add a short section in PRD about "cost-awareness" toggles (user-configurable batching hints) — could help customers tune unit economics.
- Consider adding a smoke-test that exercises fallback routing path proactively (synthetic).
- Remember to attach final canary runbook to Confluence PRD page.

Meeting timeline (today):
- 09:30 Eng+SRE sync (done)
- 11:00 GTM sync (prepare draft)
- 13:30 Design review (check UX for error page + retry flow)
- 15:00 Canary runbook review (with Ops)

Done / in-progress list:
- [ ] PRD edits (in progress)
- [x] Eng perf check (Ben)
- [ ] Canary pipeline update (Ling)
- [ ] Soak schedule (Marcus)
- [ ] GTM messaging (to send)
- [ ] Billing/cost estimate (waiting on finance)

End-of-day plan:
- Finish PRD edits and push to Confluence.
- Confirm canary rolling mode implemented by Ling.
- Triage embedding bug with Ben — need repro steps + test case.
- Send stakeholder update (1-paragraph) + link to runbook.

Random notes to self / reminders:
- Revisit onboarding checklist for new PMs — include example runbook fragments.
- Update personal TODO: schedule 1:1 with Ben next week to go over kernel tradeoffs.
- Add link to replay of perf demo in Confluence page after Ben uploads artifacts.

Jira / Links to paste later:
- JIRA-API-3245 (embedding-batch-failure)
- CONFLUENCE-PRD-LAUNCH-1 (PRD draft)
- GH-PR-4210 (runtime tests)

-- Aisha
